tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skye dgu'i bdag po la rigs lam gsal byed bzhugs so//

gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor zhing*/ 'khor lo gsum po re re la'ang lung gi chos 'khor dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gnyis gnyis su yod/ lung gi chos 'khor la yang*/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' dang*/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ bstan bcos la yang*/ bka' spyi'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ bka' so so'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ dang po la yang*/ brjod bya gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ rjod byed dag par byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas gtan tshigs kyi rig pa dang*/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos rnams yin no/ /des na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa dag gis rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par bya dgos te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur zhing*// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i gnas lnga ni/ sgra rig pa dang*/ tshad ma rig pa/ bzo rig pa dang*/ gso ba rig pa/ nang rig pa dang lnga la byed/ de yang*/ sgra rig pa dang*/ tshad ma rig pa gnyis kyis grub mtha' ngan pa tshar gcod par byed pa dang*/ bzo rig pa dang*/ gso ba rig pa gnyis kyis gzhan rjes su 'dzin par byed/ nang rig pas ni rang nyid kun shes par byed pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang*// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos de la yang*/ phyi rol pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos dang*/

nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos kyi srol thog mar 'byed pa po ni/ phyogs glang yab sras yin te/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu ba brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ de dag gi don phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa mdzad cing*/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa la dpal chos kyi grags pas gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang*/ 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi ste/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos sde bdun mdzad pa yin no// gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum ni/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ cung zad bsdus pa tshad ma rnam nges/ shin tu bsdus pa tshad ma rigs thigs dang gsum la byed/ 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi ni/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan sgrub pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa dang bzhi la byed/ de dag gi brjod don bsdus na rtog ge'i lus brgyad du 'dus shing*/ rtog ge'i lus brgyad ni/ mngon sum yang dag dang mngon sum ltar snang*/ rjes dpag yang dag dang rjes dpag ltar snang*/ sgrub ngag yang dag dang sgrub ngag ltar snang*/ sun 'byin yang dag dang sun 'byin ltar snang gnyis te brgyad la byed pa yin te/ rigs sgo las/ mngon sam dang ni rjes sa dpag/ ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed// sgrub pa dang ni sun 'byin ngag/ ltar snang bcas pa gzhan go byed// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag gi don 'chad par byed pa la/ shes byed tshad ma'i rang bzhin ngos bzung ba dang*/ tshad ma des shes bya gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ thog mar gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag /rjes su bzung nas gzhal bya'i gnas gsum la mkhas par byed pa'i yan lag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ the tshom can rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag rtags dang sgrub ngag

/log rtog can tshar bcad pa'i yan lag thal 'gyur/ de gnyis kyi sgrub don du gyur pa'i bsgrub bya bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ brjod bya rtags kyi rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ rjod byed sgrub ngag gi rnam par gzhag pa gnyis su yod/ dang po brjod bya rtags kyi rnam gzhag la/ rtags yang dag dang*/ ltar snang*/ rtags kyi skyon bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid/ tshul gsum gyi rnam gzhag rtags kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dngos/ mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba/ sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ rigs sgo las/ gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid ni tshul gsum tshang ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ phyogs chos de chas khyab pa yi// gtan tshigs */ zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ phyogs chos grub cing 'brel ba nges// gtan tshigs mtshan nyid skyon med yin// zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa'i tshe byas pa dang*/ du ldan gyi la la me yod par sgrub pa la du ba yod pa rtags su bkod pa'i tshe du ba yod pa lta bu la byed/ yang na byas pa dang du ba yod pa lta bu la byed/ de sgrub pa ni/ byas pa chos can/ rtags yang dag yin par thal/ tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ khyod tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin par thal/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ der thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos kyi tshul tshang ba gang zhig

khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul dang ldog tshul gnyis ka tshang ba'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos grub par thal/ byas pa de/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ der thal/ sgra byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul dang ldog tshul gnyis ka tshang bar thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul tshang ba gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog tshul tshang ba'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul tshang bar thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes khyab grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ de grub par thal/ byas na mi rtag pas khyab pa grub pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog tshul tshang bar thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog khyab grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ de grub par thal/ rtag na ma byas pas khyab pa grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul la/ rtsa ba'i sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul/ rtags kyi tsher ma 'byin pa'i tshul/ sgrub ngag bkod nas rjes dpag bskyed pa'i tshul dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag pa yin pa la shes 'dod the tshom dang ldan pa'i phyi rgol gyi ngor/ snga rgol gyis sgra chos can/

mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rtags kyi tsher ma 'byin pa'i tshul ni/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rtags kyis phyogs chos sgrub pa/ ltos med kyi rtags kyis rjes 'gro sgrub pa/ gnod pa can gyi rtags kyis ldog pa sgrub pa la byed pa yin no// gsum pa sgrub ngag bkod nas rjes dpag bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar sgrubs pa la brten nas byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i tshul gsum shes zhing mi dran pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor/ sngar rgol gyis gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ /zhes bkod pa la brten nas byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum cig car du dran zhing*/ de'i skad cig gnyis par byas pa'i rtags las sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skye ba yin no// gnyis pa tshul gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ tshul gsum so so'i ngo bo bshad pa dang*/ tshul gsum gyi ltos gzhi bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ tshul gsum ni/ phyogs chos kyi tshul/ rjes 'gro'i tshul/ ldog tshul dang gsum la byed/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi ltos gzhi phyogs la gtso bor ltos pa'i rtags tshul de/ phyogs chos kyi tshul gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa shes 'dod chos can sgra'i steng du 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas nges pa'i cha lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rjes 'gro'i tshul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi ltos gzhi mthun phyogs la gtso bor ltos pa'i rtags tshul de/ rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa de byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa nyid du skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas nges pa'i cha lta bu la byed/

gsum pa ldog tshul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi ltos gzhi mi mthun phyogs la gtso bor ltos pa'i rtags tshul de/ ldog tshul gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa de byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs kho na la med pa nyid du skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas nges pa'i cha lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa tshul gsum gyi ltos gzhi bshad pa la/ tshul dang po'i ltos gzhi phyogs bshad pa dang*/ rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi ltos gzhi mthun phyogs bshad pa dang*/ ldog pa'i tshul gyi ltos gzhi mi mthun phyogs bshad pa/ phyogs sgra gang la 'jug pa'i gzhi bshad pa dang bzhir yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi phyogs chos gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhir gyur pa de/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi tshul dang po'i ltos gzhi phyogs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i shes 'dod chos can du gyur pa'i sgra lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi ltos gzhi mthun phyogs bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi rjes khyab gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhir gyur pa de/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi ltos gzhi mthun phyogs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgol bas mi rtag par nges pa'i bum pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ldog pa'i tshul gyi ltos gzhi mi mthun phyogs bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi ldog khyab gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhir gyur pa de/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi ldog tshul gyi ltos gzhi mi mthun phyogs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgol bas rtag par nges pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa phyogs sgra gang la 'jug pa'i gzhi bshad pa ni/ phyogs zhes pa'i sgra de/

gnas skabs gsum la 'jug pa yin te/ phyogs chos gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ shes 'dod chos can la 'jug pa dang*/ khyab pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ bsgrub bya'i chos la 'jug pa dang*/ bsgrub bya gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ chos dang chos can gyi tshogs don la 'jug pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ phyogs chos de chas khyab pa yi/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ phyogs ni chos can no/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ chos dang 'brel ba'i phyogs kyi sgra// rtsod gzhi nyid yin/ zhes dang*/ bde blag rtogs phyir phyogs zhes gsungs// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ mdo las/ gtan tshigs bsgrub bya'i rjes 'gro ba// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags gsum pa grub ste/ rigs gter las/ phyogs ni chos dang chos can gyi// tshogs pa brjod la dngos ming yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtags kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye bshad pa ni/ rtags yang dag de la bsgrub bya'i chos kyi sgo nas dbye na/ sgrub rtags yang dag dang*/ dgag rtags yang dag gnyis/ sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag dang*/ tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gnyis/ sgrub byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag /grags pa'i rtags yang dag /yid ches pa'i rtags yang dag dang gsum du yod/ mthun phyogs la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa dang*/ rnam gnyis su 'jug pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'bras rang ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gsum/ rgol ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ rang don skabs kyi rtags yang dag dang*/ gzhan don skabs kyi rtags yang dag gnyis su yod pa yin no// dbye sgo dang po la gnyis yod pa las/ dang po sgrub rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig /khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yin na sgrub pa yin pas khyab pa de/

khyod de sgrub kyi sgrub rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs yang dag dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs yang dag rnams la byed/ gnyis pa dgag rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yin na dgag pa yin pas khyab pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi dgag rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag rnams la byed/ dbye sgo gnyis pa (sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na )gnyis yod pa las/ dang po don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yin na don nam mtshan nyid gang rung yin pas khyab pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ yod pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yin na tha snyad kho na yin pas khyab pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ri bong can chos can/ zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du rung ste/ rtog yul na yod pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/

dbye sgo gsum pa sgrub byed kyi sgo nas dbye na gsum yod pa las/ dang po dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa grags pa'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtog pas btags pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ grags pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ri bong can chos can/ zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod rung yin te/ rtog yul na yod pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa yid ches pa'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsgrub bya shin tu lkog gyur sgrub pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ yid ches pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sbyin sogs chos can/ khyod spyad pa las bde ba 'byung ste/ de 'byung bar dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ dbye sgo bzhi pa (mthun phyogs la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na )gnyis yod pa las/ dang po mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yin na khyod yin pas khyab pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa'i rtags yang dag la/

mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya de la khyod yin min gnyis yod pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dung sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ dbye sgo lnga pa (sbyor ba'i sgo nas dbye na )gsum yod pa las/ dang po 'bras bu'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba/ cha mthun khongs su bsdu ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi sgrub rtags yang dag gang zhig /khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi rtags chos gnyis la de byung 'brel pa nges byed kyi tshad ma grub pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi 'bras rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rgyu dngos sgrub kyi 'bras rtags/ rgyu sngon song sgrub kyi 'bras rtags/ rgyu'i rang ldog sgrub kyi 'bras rtags/ rgyu'i khyad par sgrub kyi 'bras rtags dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ du ldan gyi la la chos can/ me yod de/ du ba yod pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rgyu sngon song sgrub kyi 'bras rtags ni/ nam mkha'i du ba sngo long po chos can/ rang rgyu me sngon song yin te/ du ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa rgyu'i rang ldog sgrub kyi 'bras rtags ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa chos can/ rgyu dang bcas pa yin te/ res 'ga' skye ba'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa rgyu'i khyad par sgrub kyi 'bras rtags ni/ gzugs 'dzin dbang shes chos can/ khyod la dbang yid las gzhan pa'i rgyu yod de/ de med na mi skye zhing res 'ga' skye ba'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/

gsum pa cha mthun khongs su bsdu ba ni/ bur ro da lta ba'i rtags las kha nang bu ram gong bu'i steng du bur gzugs da lta ba yod par sgrub pa lta bu la byed pa yin no// gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de sgrub kyi sgrub rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi rtags chos gnyis la bdag gcig 'brel nges byed kyi tshad ma grub pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rang bzhin ltos pa ba'i rtags yang dag dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa ba'i rtags yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rang bzhin dag pa ba'i rtags yang dag ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la yod pa nyid rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ rang bzhin khyad par bye brag la// ltos pa'am 'on te 'ba' zhig pa// bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i phyir brjod de// 'jig la 'bras dang yod nyid bzhin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag la dbye na/ mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang*/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang du mi rung ba'i dgag bya 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mdun gyi gzhi 'dir chos can/ 'dre sha za'i bum pa yod nges kyi tha snyad mi 'jug ste/ de tha mal pa'i tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang du rung ba'i dgag bya 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/

gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang*/ 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig /'brel yul bkag pa'i sgo nas shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du 'brel zla 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rgyu/ khyab byed/ rang bzhin/ dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ me med mtshan mo'i rgya mtsho na chos can/ du ba med de/ me med pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ shing med kyi brag rdzong der chos can/ sha pa med de/ shing med pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ bum pas dag pa'i sa phyogs su chos can/ bum pa med de/ snang rung gi bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ du ba med pa'i gyang rar chos can/ du rgyu nus pa thogs med med de/ dngos 'bras du ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig /'gal ba rtags su bkod pa'i sgo nas shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du 'gal zla 'gog pa la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag dang*/ phan tshun spang 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig /rtags su bzung bya dang chos log tu bzung bya gnyis la lhan cig mi gnas 'gal du nges byed kyi tshad ma grub pa de/

lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa bzhi/ 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa bzhi/ 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa bzhi dang bcu gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag dang bzhi la byed/ dang po ni/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ /grang reg rgyun chags pa med de/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags pa med de/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ de chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med rgyun chags pa med de/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ de chos can/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags pa med de/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa bzhi ni/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang bzhi la byed/ dang po ni/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang reg rgyun chags pa med de/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags pa med de/

du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ de chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med rgyun chags pa med de/ rtags gong bzhin/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ de chos can/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags pa med de/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa bzhi ni/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa dang bzhi la byed/ dang po ni/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang reg rgyun chags pa med de/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags pa med de/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ de chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med rgyun chags pa med de/ rtags sngar bzhin/ bzhi pa ni/ de chos can/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags pa med de/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa phan tshun spang 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig /rtags su bzung bya dang chos log tu bzung bya gnyis phan tshun spang 'gal du nges byed kyi tshad ma grub pa de/ phan tshun spang 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ ltos pas nges pa 'gog pa dang*/

nges pas ltos pa 'gog pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi rtags yang dag gnyis/ dang po ni/ nas myug gi rgyu tshogs kha yar tshang ba'i gzhir chos can/ rang 'bras nas myug 'byung nges ma yin te/ de 'byung ba phyis 'byung gi rgyu don gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bum pa chos can/ 'jig pa phyis 'byung gi rgyu don gzhan la mi ltos te/ 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ dbye sgo drug pa (rgol ba'i sgo nas dbye na )la gnyis las/ dang po rang don skabs kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don skabs kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ rang don skabs kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgol ba gzhan la ma ltos par rgol ba rang nyid kyis/ gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas sa/ོ/ zhes bkod pa la brten nas byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum gcig car du dran pa'i tshe byas pa de/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gzhan don skabs kyi rtags yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan don skabs kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ gzhan don skabs kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sngar rgol gyis bkod pa'i rtags yang dag dang*/ phyir rgol gyis bkod pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa gtan tshigs ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i gtan tshigs de/ gtan tshigs ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ gtan tshigs ltar snang de las gzhan// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/ 'gal ma nges ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs ltar snang gsum du yod/ dang po 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs gang zhig

khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi khyab pa'i tshul gnyis phyin ci log tu nges pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ chos kyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags/ chos can gyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags/ chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags/ chos can gyi khyad par 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ sgra byas par shes shing byas mi rtag gi 'brel ba mi shes pa'i rgol ba'i ngor/ sgra rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos gyur gyi nam mkha' rtag par sgrub pa la 'dus ma byas rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ mig sogs chos can/ 'dus pa ma yin pa'i yul can gzhan don byed de/ 'dus shing bsags pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ mig sogs 'dus pa ma yin pa'i yul can chos can/ gzhan don byed de/ 'dus shing bsags pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyi de sgrub kyi khyab pa'i tshul gnyis rnal log gang du yang ma nges pa de/ khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/

de la dbye na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ma nges pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs su song ba'i rgol ba des khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs gnyis po gang la yang yod par ma mthong ba de/ khyod de sgrub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ phyogs gnyis ka la med nas ma mthong ba dang*/ phyogs gnyis ka la yod kyang ma mthong ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs la med mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba dang*/ mthun phyogs la med mi mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ sgra mnyan byar shes shing mnyan bya dang mi rtag pa'i 'brel pa mi shes pa'i rgol ba'i ngor/ sgra rtag sgrub la mnyan bya rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa phyogs gnyis ka la yod kyang ma mthong ba ni/ mdun gyi skyes bu lha las tshe 'phos par sgrub pa la mig dang ldan pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa mi mthun phyogs la med mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba ni/ sgra byas par shes shing byas mi rtag gi 'brel pa mi shes pa'i rgol ba'i ngor/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa mthun phyogs la med mi mthun phyogs la yod kyang ma mthong ba ni/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la skabs su bab pa'i rgol ba'i ngor/ nam mkha' mi rtag par sgrub pa la ma byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs la/ dngos kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs dang*/ lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs su song ba'i rgol ba des khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs gnyis ka la yod par mthong ba de/

khyod de sgrub kyi dngos kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ phyogs gnyis ka la khyab byed du yod pa/ de gnyis ka la rnam gnyis su yod pa/ mthun phyogs la khyab byed mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su yod pa/ mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su yod pa dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ sgra rtag sgrub la gzhal bya rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa de gnyis ka la rnam gnyis su yod pa ni/ sgra rtag sgrub la reg bya can ma yin pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa mthun phyogs la khyab byed mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su yod pa ni/ rig sgra rtsol byung du sgrub pa la mi rtag pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su yod pa ni/ rig sgra rtsol ma byung du sgrub pa la mi rtag pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs su song ba'i rgol ba des khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs gnyis po gang rung la yod par mthong zhing gcig shos la yod par yang ma mthong med par yang ma mthong ba de/ khyod de sgrub kyi lhag ldan gyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ yang dag lhag ldan dang*/ 'gal ba lhag ldan gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod de sgrub kyi lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs su song ba'i rgol ba des khyod de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs la yod par mthong zhing mi mthun phyogs la yod med gang du yang ma mthong ba de/ khyod de sgrub kyi yang dag lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/

gang zhig ma mthong ba tsam gyis// ldog par rab tu ston byed pa// de ni the tshom rgyu yin phyir// de la lhag ma ldan zhes brjod// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra byas par shes shing byas pa mi rtag pa la rjes su 'gro ba tsam shes pa'i rgol ba'i ngor/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa 'gal ba lhag ldan la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod de sgrub kyi lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod de sgrub kyi lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs su song ba'i rgol ba des khyod de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la yod par mthong zhing mthun phyogs la yod med gang du yang ma mthong ba de/ khyod de sgrub kyi 'gal ba lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtags su bkod pa gang zhig /rtags shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du ma grub pa de/ ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ phyogs chos don la ma grub pa dang*/ blo ngo la ltos te ma grub pa dang*/ rgol ba la ltos te ma grub pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ chos can gyi ngo bo med nas ma grub pa dang*/ rtags kyi ngo bo med nas ma grub pa dang*/ rtags kyi ngo bo yod kyang rtags phyogs chos su mi rung ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ ri bong rwa mi rtag par sgrub pa la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa rtags kyi ngo bo med nas ma grub pa ni/ bum pa mi rtag par sgrub pa la dbang phyug rtag pas byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gsum pa rtags kyi ngo bo yod kyang rtags phyogs chos suu mi rung ba la/ rtags shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du ma grub pa dang/ rtags shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du grub kyang phyogs chos su mi rung ba gnyis su yod/

dang po la/ rtags ril po chos can gyi steng du ma grub pa dang*/ rtags gyi phyogs gcig chos can gyi steng du ma grub pa dang*/ rtags chos can gyi phyogs gcig la ma grub pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la mig shes kyi gzung bya rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes mngon sum du sgrub pa la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ shing sems ldan du sgrub pa la mtshan mo lo ma 'khums nas nyal ba rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rtags shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du grub kyang phyogs chos su mi rung ba la/ gzhi rtags tha dad med nas ma grub pa dang*/ chos rtags tha dad med nas ma grub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la sgra rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la mi rtag pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa blo ngo la ltos te ma grub pa la/ rtags kyi ngo bo la the tshom za nas ma grub pa dang*/ chos can gyi ngo bo la the tshom za nas ma grub pa/ de gnyis ka'i 'brel pa la the tshom za nas ma grub pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bum pa mi rtag par sgrub pa la 'dre sha zas byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dre sha za'i bum pa mi rtag par sgrub pa la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ ri sul gsum gyi dbus ma na rma bya yod par sgrub pa la rma bya'i sgra grags pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa rgol ba la ltos te ma grub pa la/ sngar rgol la ltos te ma grub pa dang*/ phyir rgol la ltos te ma grub pa/ gnyis ka la ltos te ma grub pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sngar rgol grangs can gyis phyir rgol sangs rgyas pa'i ngor/ blo bde sems med du sgrub pa la skye 'jig can rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/

sngar rgaul gcer bu pas phyir rgol sangs rgyas pa'i ngor/ shing sems ldan du sgrub pa la shun pa bshus na 'chi ba rtags su bkod pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sgra byas par mi shes pa'i sngar rgol gyis sgra byas par mi shes pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa rtags skyon la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum gang rung gi bsal byar tshad mas dmigs pa de/ rtags skyon gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa la/ phyogs chos kyi tshul gyi skyon/ rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi skyon/ ldog tshul gyi skyon dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ phyogs chos kyi tshul gyi bsal byar tshad mas dmigs pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos kyi tshul gyi skyon dang*/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos kyi tshul gyi skyon gnyis/ dang po ni/ mig shes kyi gzung bya sgra'i steng du ma grub pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra byas par skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas mi shes pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi skyon la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi bsal byar tshad mas dmigs pa de/ rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi skyon gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi skyon dang*/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro'i tshul gyi skyon gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhal bya'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes khyab grub pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ byas pa mi rtag pa la rjes su 'gro bar skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas mi shes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ldog tshul gyi skyon la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ldog tshul gyi bsal byar tshad mas dmigs pa de/

ldog tshul gyi skyon gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog tshul gyi skyon dang*/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog tshul gyi skyon gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhal bya'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog tshul grub pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ byas pa rtag pa las ldog par skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas mi shes pa lta bu la byed/ des na rtags su bkod pa thams cad gtan tshigs ltar snang gsum dang yang dag gcig dang bzhir 'dus shing*/ de dag gi byed las ni/ ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs la bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i mthu med pas de la brten nas bsgrub bya la ma rtogs pa'i blo skye ba dang*/ ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs la brten nas bsgrub bya la the tshom gyi blo skye ba dang*/ 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs la brten nas bsgrub bya la phyin ci log tu rtog pa'i blo skye ba dang*/ rtags yang dag la brten nas bsgrub bya ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i tshad ma skye ba yin te/ tshad ma mdo las/ rtags sa bkod pa bzhi ra 'das// rtags sa bkod pa bzhi po la// nas pa de yang rnam bzhir yod// phyogs la mtha med som nyi dang*// mi 'dod 'dod pa nges sgrub byed// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rjod byed sgrub pa'i ngag gi rnam par gzhag pa la/ sgrub ngag yang dag dang*/ sgrub ngag ltar snang dang*/ rgol phyir rgol dpang po gsum gyi rnam gzhag dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ rang don skabs kyi sgrub ngag yang dag dang*/ gzhan don skabs kyi sgrub ngag yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ rang don skabs kyi gtan tshigs rnam dag rang don skabs kyi sgrub ngag yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ /zhes pa'i ngag de rang don skabs kyi sgrub ngag yang dag tu song ba'i tshe lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa gzhan don skabs kyi sgrub ngag yang dag dang*/

gzhan don rjes dpag don gcig cing*/ 'di la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol ba rang gi tshad mas mthong ba'i rtags kyi tshul gsum skabs su bab pa'i rgol ba gzhan gyi dran lam du gsal bar ston pa'i ngag rnam dag de/ gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag gam gzhan don rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ tshad ma mdor/ gzhan don rjes sa dpag pa ni// rang gi mthong don rab gsal byed/ /ces dang*/ rigs gter las/ gzhan don rjes dpag rang nyid kyis// mthong ba gzhan la ston pa'i ngag/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag gi mtshan nyid kyi zur du mthong ba zhes smos pas ni rang gi bstan byar gyur pa'i tshul gsum rgol ba rang gi tshad mas ma mthong ba'i ngag rnams gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin pa bsal nas/ gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin na rang gi bstan byar gyur pa'i tshul gsum rgol ba rang gi tshad mas mthong ba zhig dgos par bstan pa yin te/ de spang phyir bdag mthong ba'i tshig/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ don zhes smos pas rang gi bstan byar gyur pa'i tshul gsum don la ma grub pa rnams gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin pa bsal nas gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin na rang gi bstan byar gyur pa'i tshul gsum don la grub pa zhig dgos par bstan pa yin te/ don smos de ni sgra dag dang*// rtog pas sgro btags bdag nyid can// rtags nyid min par grub don te// don las don ni grub phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ don yod shes la ltos bcas yin// med pa shes pa sgrub byed min// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rab gsal byed ces smos pas ni/ ngag lhag chad can rnams gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin pa bsal nas gzhan don sgrub ngag yang dag yin na rang gi bstan byar gyar pa'i tshal gsam lhag chad med par rgol ba'i dran lam da gsal bar ston pa zhig dgos par bstan pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ yan lag lnga las dam bca' dang*//

nye sbyor 'jug sdud gsum po lhag/ spyi khyab ma tshang phyir mi 'thad// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dgos pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bsgrub bya sgrub phyir du bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag dang*/ dgag bya 'gog phyir du bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag gnyis su yod/ rgol ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ sngar rgol gyis bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag dang*/ phyir rgol gyis bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag gnyis su yod/ brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rang rgyud du gyur pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag dang*/ thal 'gyur du gyur pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag gnyis su yod/ de yang bsgrub bya bsgrub phyir du bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag /sngar rgol gyis bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag /rang rgyud du gyur pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag gsum don gcig cing*/ de la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar rgol rang gi tshad mas mthong ba'i rtags kyi tshul gsum phyir rgol gyi dran lam du gsal bar ston pa'i ngag rnam dag de gsum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rtsa ba'i bsgrub bya sgrub phyir du bkod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag dang*/ tshul gsum sgrub phyir du bkod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ chos mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag dang*/ chos mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag /phyogs chos rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag /rjes 'gro rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag /ldog pa rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag dang lngar yod/

dang po chos mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub ngag yang dag gang zhig /de skor gyi shes 'dod chos can dang dpe'i chos can gnyis rtags dang chos su mthun par sbyor ba'i ngag de/ chos mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ zhes pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa chos mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub ngag yang dag gang zhig /de skor gyi shes 'dod chos can dang dpe'i chos can gnyis rtags dang chos su mi mthun par sbyor ba'i ngag de/ chos mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gang rtag na ma byas pas khyab/ dper na/ nam mkha' bzhin/ sgra ni byas so/ /zhes pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ gsum pa phyogs chos rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag gi mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshad mas shes shing khyab 'brel ma brjed khar 'byin phyogs chos mi dran dran rung du yod pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor sngar rgol gyis/ 'o na sgra yang byas so/ /zhes pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ de 'dra'i ngag de chos can/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag yin te/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum byas pa'i rtags kyi sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir rgol gyi dran lam du gsal bar ston pa'i ngag rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ rigs gter las/ mkhas pa la ni gtan tshigs nyid/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ gtan tshigs brjod pas khyab pa dran nus pa de la gtan tshigs tsam gyis 'grub ste/ dper na/ byas na mi rtag pas khyab par smra ba'i rgol ba mkhas pa de la 'o na sgra yang byas so zhes pas 'grub pa bzhin no/

/zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gong gi khyab pa grub ste/ tshul gsum ston pa sgrub pa'i ngag /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rjes 'gro rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag ni/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshad mas shes shing phyogs chos ma brjed khar 'byin rjes khyab mi dran dran rung du yod pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor/ gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ lnga pa ldog pa rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag ni/ byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshad mas shes shing phyogs chos ma brjed khar 'byin ldog khyab mi dran dran rung du yod pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor/ gang rtag na ma byas pas khyab/ dper na/ nam mkha' bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i sgrub ngag yang dag 'god pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir rgol gyi ngor byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun sbyor dang mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag gnyis ka 'god dgos pa ma yin te/ ngag gang rung gcig bkod pas cig shos don gyis go ba'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ de nyid kyi phyir 'brel shes na// gnyis las gang yang rang smras pas// don gyi go bas cig shos la// dran pa yang dag skye bar gyar/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshul gsum sgrub phyir du bkod pa'i sgrub ngag ni/ phyir rgol gyis snga rgol la sgra rtag gam mi rtag dris pa'i tshe/ sngar rgol gyis sgra mi rtag par dam 'cha'/ phyir rgol gyis de'i sgrub byed dris pa na/ sngar rgol gyis/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes rtsa ba'i sbyor ba 'god/ phyir rgol gyis byas pa'i rtags kyi sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i sgrub byed dris pa na/ sngar rgol gyis/ gang rgyu rkyen las skyes na byas pa yin pas khyab/

dper na/ mngon gsal gyi bum pa bzhin/ rig byed kyi sgra yang rgyu rkyen las skyes so/ /zhes pa'i sgrub ngag bkod pa'i sgo nas byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos sgrub/ gang phyis rgyu don gzhan la ltos med du 'jig na 'jig nges yin pas khyab/ dper na/ mar me skad cig ma tha ma bzhin/ bum pa yang phyis rgyu don gzhan la ltos med du 'jig go /zhes bkod pa'i sgo nas rjes khyab sgrub/ gang don byed mi nus na byas pas stong pas khyab/ dper na/ nam mkha' bzhin/ dbang phyug rtag pa yang byas pas stong ngo*/ /zhes bkod pa'i sgo nas ldog khyab sgrub pa lta bu la byed pa yin no// yang dgag bya 'gog phyir du bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag/ phyir rgol gyis bkod pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag /thal 'gyur du gyur pa'i gzhan don rjes dpag gsum don gcig cing*/ de la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ phyir rgol rang gi tshad mas mthong ba'i rtags kyi tshul gsum skabs su bab pa'i sngar rgol gyi dran lam du gsal bar ston pa'i ngag rnam dag de gsum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ chos mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag /chos mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag khas blangs pa'i rtags rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag /rjes 'gro rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag /ldog pa rkyang pa brjod pa'i sgrub ngag khyab pa mi shes pa la khyab pa'i log phyogs sun 'byin pa'i sgrub ngag /thal chos la tshad ma'i bsal ba zhugs tshul mi shes pa la tshad ma'i bsal ba zhugs tshul ston pa'i sgrub ngag dang bdun du yod/ gnyis pa sgrub ngag ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub ngag tu bkod pa gang zhig /skyon gsum po gang rung dang bcas pa de/ sgrub ngag ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ rigs gter las/ sgrub byed yang dag ma yin pa// bkod pa sgrub pa ltar snang yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/

de la dbye na/ don skyon can gyi sgrub ngag /blos skyon can gyi sgrub ngag /sgras skyon can gyi sgrub ngag dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ don blo sgra yi dbye ba yis// ltar snang de la rnam pa gsum/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ sgrub ngag de'i bstan byar gyur pa'i tshul gsum ma tshang ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ tshul gsum gyi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i rgol bas bkod pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan lta bu la byed/ yan lag lnga ldan gyi ngag ni/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum pa bzhin/ bum pa byas pa de bzhin du sgra yang byas/ de'i phyir/ sgra mi rtag ces pa'i ngag lta bu la byed/ rgol phyir rgol dpang po gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ gsum pa rgol phyir rgol dpang po gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ tshar bcad kyi gnas bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub byed brjod par khas len pa'i sngar rgol/ sun 'byin brjod par khas len pa'i phyir rgol/ rgyal pham brda sprod par khas len pa'i dpang po dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ rgol dang phyir rgol dpang po gsum// sgrub dang sun 'byin brda sprod pa'o// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po sngar rgol la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs snga ma khas len pa'i rgol ba de/ sngar rgol gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sngar rgol yang dag dang*/ sngar rgol ltar snang gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs snga ma yang dag brjod pa de/ sngar rgol yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ dam bca' yang dag 'jog pa'i sngar rgol dang*/ sgrub byed yang dag 'god pa'i sngar rgol gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag par dam 'cha' ba'i sngar rgol lta bu/

gnyis pa ni/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god pa'i sngar rgol lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa sngar rgol ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs snga ma ltar snang khas len pa de/ sngar rgol ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ dam bca' 'jog rgyu med pa dang*/ skabs su ma bab pa'i dam bca' 'jog pa dang*/ dam bca' ltar snang 'jog pa ste dam bca' 'jog tshul la ltos pa'i sngar rgol gsum dang*/ sgrub byed 'god rgyu med pa dang*/ skabs su ma bab pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa dang*/ sgrub byed ltar snang 'god pa ste sgrub byed 'god tshul la ltos pa'i sngar rgol ltar snang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa phyir rgol la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs phyi ma khas len pa'i rgol ba de/ phyir rgol gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ phyir rgol yang dag dang*/ phyir rgol ltar snang gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs phyi ma yang dag khas len pa'i rgol ba de/ phyir rgol yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ 'dod pa 'dri ba'i phyir rgol dang*/ sun 'byin brjod pa'i phyir rgol gnyis/ dang po la/ dam bca' 'dri ba dang*/ sgrub byed 'dri ba/ de'i yang sgrub byed 'dri ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag ces 'dri ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar rgol gyis sgra rtag par dam bcas nas de'i sgrub byed 'dri ba lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ sngar rgol gyis sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa na/ de'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes 'dri ba lta bu la byed/ de la sngar rgol gyis rtags kyi tsher ma phyungs nas phyir rgol gyi rgyud la rjes dpag bskyed par byed pa ni phyir rgol yang dag tu 'jog pa'i rim pa gcig yin no//

gnyis pa sun 'byin brjod pa'i phyir rgol la/ dam bca' la sun 'byin brjod pa dang*/ sgrub byed la sun 'byin brjod pa'i phyir rgol gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar rgol gyis sgra rtag par dam bcas pa na/ sgra chos can/ ma byas par thal/ rtag pa'i phyir zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar rgol gyis sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa na/ 'o na/ dngos po rnams kyang rtag par thal/ gzhal bya la rtag pas khyab pa'i phyir zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa phyir rgol ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so sor bshams nas rtsod pa'i skabs su phyogs phyi ma ltar snang khas len pa de/ phyir rgol ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ 'dod pa 'dri tshul la ltos pa'i phyir rgol ltar snang dang*/ sun 'byin rjod tshul la ltos pa'i phyir rgol ltar snang gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ phyir rgol du khas blangs nas 'dod pa mi 'dri ba dang*/ skabs su ma bab pa 'dri ba dang*/ skabs su bab pa 'dri mi shes pa dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa sun 'byin rjod tshul la ltos pa'i phyir rgol ltar snang la/ sngar rgol gyi dam bca' ltar snang dang sgrub byed ltar snang la sun 'byin brjod rgyu med pa dang*/ sun 'byin ltar snang brjod pa gnyis su yod/ gsum pa dpang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol rgyal 'pham brda sprod par khas len pa'i rgol ba de/ dpang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rnam par dbye ba'i dpang po/ shan 'byed pa'i dpang po/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gyi dpang po dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ rgol phyir rgol so so'i tshig ma nor rjod nus pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ rgol phyir rgol rgyal 'pham gyi zhal lce gcod nus pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ grub mtha'i blang dor dang*/ 'jig rten gyi go 'phang la bstod smad byed nus pa lta bu la byed/

gnyis pa tshar bcad kyi gnas bye brag tu bshad pa la/ slob dpon phywa pa'i lugs dang*/ rigs gter ba'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ sngar rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas drug /phyir rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas drug /dpang po tshar bcad kyi gnas gsum/ thun mong du snang ba mi gtod pa'i tshar bcad kyi gnas gcig dang bcu drug tu yod de/ rigs gter las/ rgol ba la yang gsum gnyis drug/ phyir rgol la yang gsum gnyis drug/ dpang po la gsum kun la gcig/ gangs can pa rnams bca drag 'dod// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rigs gter ba ltar na/ tshar bcad kyi gnas la sngar rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas dang*/ phyir rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dam bca' yang dag bzhag nas sgrub byed yang dag 'god par khas blangs pa'i rgol ba gang zhig /sgrub byed yang dag mi brjod pa de/ sngar rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgrub byed tsam mi brjod pa dang*/ sgrub byed ltar snang brjod pa gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa phyir rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar rgol gyi dam bca' dang sgrub byed ltar snang la skyon brjod par khas blangs pa'i rgol ba gang zhig /skyon mi brjod pa de/ phyir rgol tshar bcad kyi gnas kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ skyon tsam mi brjod pa'i dang*/ skyon ltar snang brjod pa gnyis su yod de/ rtsod rigs las/ bsgrub pa'i yan lag mi brjod cing*// skyon mi brjod pa gnyis po dag/ tshar bcad pa yi gnas yin te// gzhan ni mi rigs phyir mi 'thad/ /ces dang*/ rigs gter las/ tshar bcad gnyis las phye ba'i bzhi// rigs pa mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa log rtog can tshar bcad pa'i yan lag thal 'gyur bshad pa la/ thal 'gyur yang dag dang*/ ltar snang*/ de la lan 'debs tshul dang gsum/ dang po thal 'gyur yang dag la/

mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtags khas blangs khyab pa tshad mas grub dam bca' la tshad mas bsal ba 'jug tu rung ba de/ thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag dang*/ sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig /rang gi ldog don la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa de/ sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ ldog pa rang ris 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag dang*/ ldog pa gzhan ris 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig /rang gis 'phangs pa'i ldog don gyi gtan tshigs de rang dang ming ris mthun par gnas pa de/ ldog pa rang ris 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur/ phan tshun spangs 'gal la brten pa'i khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur dang bzhir yod de/ rigs gter las/

ldog pa rang ris 'phen pa bzhi// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa ma yin par thal/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin te/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa yin no// gnyis pa rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ du ba drag tu phyur bas khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ du ba drag tu phyur bas khyab par non pa ma yin par thal/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags dang ldan pa ma yin te/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa ma yin par thal/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin te/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/

bzhi pa phan tshun spang 'gal la brten pa'i khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur ni/ bum pa chos can/ 'jig nges ma yin par thal/ 'jig pa phyis 'byung gi rgyu don gzhan la ltos pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ bum pa chos can/ 'jig pa phyis 'byung gi rgyu don gzhan la mi ltos te/ 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ldog pa gzhan ris 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig /rang gis 'phangs pa'i ldog don gyi gtan tshigs de rang dang ming ris mi mthun par gnas pa de/ ldog pa gzhan ris 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rgyu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa/ 'bras bu'i thal 'gyur gyis rgyu ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa/ khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs 'phen pa/ rang bzhin gyi thal 'gyur gyis khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa/ lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal dmigs kyi thal 'gyur bcu gnyis dang bcu drug tu yod de/ rigs gter las/ gzhan ris 'phen pa bcu drug yod/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po rgyu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ du ldan gyi la la chos can/ du ba med par thal/ me med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ du ldan gyi la la chos can/ me yod de/ du ba yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i thal 'gyur gyis rgyu ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ me med mtshan mo'i rgya mtshor chos can/ me yod par thal/ du ba yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ me med mtshan mo'i rgya mtshor chos can/ du ba med de/ me med pa'i phyir/

zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyis rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ sha pa dang ldan pa'i gzhir chos can/ sha pa med par thal/ shing med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ sha pa dang ldan pa'i gzhir chos can/ shing yod de/ sha pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa rang bzhin gyi thal 'gyur gyis khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa ni/ shing med kyi brag rdzong na chos can/ shing yod par thal/ sha pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ shing med kyi brag rdzong na chos can/ sha pa med de/ shing med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa'i thal 'gyur bcu gnyis ni/ tsha reg gis grang reg 'gog pa drug dang*/ grang reg gis tsha reg 'gog pa drug ste bcu gnyis la byed/ dang po drug ni/ 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa gnyis/ 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa gnyis/ 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa gnyis dang drug la byed/ dang po gnyis ni/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa dang*/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa gnyis la byed/ dang po ni/ grang 'bras spu long byed kyis khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed kyis khyab par non pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa ni/ ba mo'i reg pas khyab par non pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ ba mo'i reg pas khyab par non pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa gnyis ni/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa dang*/ khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa gnyis la byed/

dang po ni/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa khyab byed dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa ni/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ ba mo'i reg pa rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa gnyis ni/ rang bzhin dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa gnyis la byed/ dang po ni/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rgyu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa ni/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang 'bras spu long byed rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa grang reg gis tsha reg 'gog pa drug ni/ de dag gi rigs pas shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig /rang gi zlog don la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs 'phen par mi nus pa de/ sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur/ 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur/ mtshan nyid ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ rang bzhin 'bras bu mtshan nyid dai// mi dmigs gsum gyis sgrub mi 'phen// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de'i steng du 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa/

'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa dang gsum dang drug tu yod/ dang po rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur ni/ bum pa tshad mas dmigs pa'i gzhir chos can/ bum pa med par thal/ bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur ni/ tshang mang du chos can/ du rgyu nus pa thogs med med par thal/ dngos 'bras du ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa mtshan nyid ma dmigs pa'i thal 'gyur ni/ ba lang kar zal chos can/ ba lang ma yin par thal/ nog lkog shal dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dmigs pa ni/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed/ lnga pa 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa ni/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i shar gzhi chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ du ba drag phyur bas khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i khyab bya dmigs pa ni/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i shar gzhi chos can/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin par thal/ tsan me stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu la byed do// de ltar sgrub byed mi 'phen pa dang 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur gnyis yod pa las/ sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur rnams la sgrub ngag tu bkod pa dang ma bkod pa gnyis gnyis su yod pa las/ sgrub ngag tu bkod pa ni/ dper na/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhi yin na grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas khyab/ dper na tshang mang bzhin/ tsha reg stobs chen pos khyab par non pa'i gzhir grang reg rgyun chags dang ldan par khas blangs pas so/

/zhes pa lta bu la byed/ 'di la rigs gter bas sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur chos gsum ldan du bshad pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur chos gsum ldan// dngos su sgrub pa'i ngag min kyang*// zlog na sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yod/ /zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ dngos su rtags tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir sgrub pa'i ngag ma yin mod/ zlog na tshul gsum tshang bas sgrub pa yang dag go /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thal 'gyur ltar snang la/ rang gi lugs bzhag pa dang*/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa bkod pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ thal 'gyur ltar snang la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ thal 'gyur du bkod pa gang zhig /thal 'gyur yang dag gi bsal byar tshad mas dmigs pa de/ thal 'gyur ltar snang gi mtshan nyid/ thal 'gyur yang dag gi bsal bya de la rtags khas ma blangs pa/ khyab pa tshad mas ma grub pa/ dam bca' la tshad ma'i bsal ba 'jug tu mi rung ba dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'gal/ ma nges/ ma grub pa/ bsal ba ye med kyi thal 'gyur dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ sgra byas par khas len pa la/ sgra chos can/ rtag par thal/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra gzhal byar khas len pa la/ sgra chos can/ rtag par thal/ gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ sgra mnyan byar khas len pa la/ sgra chos can/ ma byas par thal/ rtag pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ sgra rtag par khas len pa la/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag par thal/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa gzhan gyi bzhed pa bkod pa ni/ slob dpon phywa pa ni/ thal 'gyur du bkod pa thams cad la rtags khyab gnyis ka ma grub pa/ rtags 'ba' zhig ma grub pa/ khyab pa 'ba' zhig ma grub pa/ rtags khyab gnyis ka grub pa ste/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi dbye ba bcu bzhir 'dod pa yin te/ rigs gter las/

thal 'gyur bzhi las bcu bzhi zhes// gangs can pa dag de ltar 'dod/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ rtog ge snga rabs pa dag /thal 'gyur ltar snang gi lan la/ 'dod lan dang*/ rtags ma grub kyi lan dang*/ khyab pa med lan dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ thal 'gyur lan ni sgo gsum zhes// kha ba can pa de skad smra// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rigs gter mdzad pa ltar na/ thal 'gyur ltar snang gi lan la/ rtags ma grub pa/ khyab pa 'gal ba/ khyab pa ma nges pa/ 'dod lan dang bzhir 'chad pa yin te/ des na mkhas pas thal 'gyur lan// rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi gdab// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum tshang ba'i thal 'gyur la ni lan gyis zlog par mi nus pas de'i rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ lan gyis zlog par ma nus na// de yi rjes 'brang dam pa'i lugs// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur ltar snang bzhi po 'di la mkhas pa gtsang nag pas tha snyad mdzad pa ni/ bsal ba ye med kyi thal 'gyur la/ rma bya dug 'joms zhes bya ba yin te/ 'dod lan btab pas rtsod pa rang zhir 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ma grub pa'i thal 'gyur la ni/ dpa' bo lag rdum zhes bya ba yin te/ rtags la khas blangs med pas tshur la zlog pa'i phyir/ ma nges pa'i thal 'gyur la ni/ mtshon cha'i khri 'gyogs zhes bya ba yin te/ rtags la khas blangs yod kyang khyab pa ma grub pas rtsod pa cher 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum tshang ba'i thal 'gyur la ni/ gnam lcags thog gi thal 'gyur zhes bya ba yin te/ lan gang gis kyang zlog par mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed do// slob dpon phywa pa ltar na/ thal 'gyur gyi rtags dang khyab pa khas blangs kyis grub pas rtags dang khyab pa grub pa'i go chod pa dang*/ khas blangs kyi bsal bas bsal ba'i go chod par 'dod la/ rigs gter mdzad pa ltar na/ thal 'gyur gyi rtags khas blangs pas thal 'gyur de ma grub pa'i thal 'gyur du mi 'jog pa tsam yin kyang*/

rtags grub pa'i go mi chod pa dang*/ khyab pa khas blangs kyis grub pa dang*/ khas blangs kyi bsal bas bsal ba'i go mi chod par 'dod cing*/ khas blangs kyi bsal bas bsal ba'i go chod na/ sngar rgol sgra byas pa dang rtag par khas len pa la/ phyir rgol gyis sgra chos can/ mi rtag par thal/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs pa thal 'gyur yang dag tu 'gyur la/ 'dod mi nus te/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur la tshad ma'i bsal ba ston rgyu med pa'i phyir/ de thal 'gyur yang dag yin na de 'dra'i thal 'gyur 'phen pa po'i phyir rgol de phyir rgol yang dag yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i phyir rgol chos can/ phyir rgol yang dag ma yin par thal/ sngar rgol gyi dam bca' ltar snang la sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur 'phen rgyu yod bzhin du sgrub byed mi 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi phyir rgol yin pa'i phyir/ des sgrub byed 'phen no zer na/ 'o na mi rtag pa ma yin pa de/ sgra ma byas par sgrub pa'i sgrub byed gtan tshigs yang dag yin par 'gyur ro zhes sogs skyon brjod par mdzad do// gsum pa de gnyis kyi grub don du gyur pa'i bsgrub bya bshad pa la/ dngos dang*/ de sgrub byed phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bsgrub bya yang dag la/ mtshan nyid/ ming gi rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ zhar la tshad mas bsal ba bshad pa dang bzhir yod/

dang po ni/ ngo bo'i don sogs chos lnga tshang ba de/ bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ chos lnga ni/ ngo bo dang*/ tshig phrad dang*/ bdag nyid dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ ma bsal ba dang lnga la byed de/ tshad ma mdor/ ngo bo kho na rang nyid dang*// 'dod cing ma bsal bstan bya ba// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de yang ngo bo zhes pa'i tshig gis bsgrub bya yang dag yin na skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas grub pa cig dgos par bstan/ tshig phrad kho na ba zhes pa'i tshig gis bsgrub bya yang dag yin na sgrub byed du bkod bzhin pa ma yin pa zhig dgos par bstan/ bdag nyid zhes pa'i tshig gis bsgrub bya yang dag yin na rgol ba bdag nyid kyis bsgrub byar khas blangs pa zhig dgos par bstan/ 'dod pa zhes pa'i tshig gis bsgrub bya yang dag yin na rgol bas dpag 'dod kyi yul du byas pa zhig dgos par bstan/ ma bsal ba zhes pa'i tshig gis bsgrub bya yang dag yin na skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas ma bsal ba zhig dgos par bstan pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ ngo bo tshig phrad bdag nyid 'dod// tshig gi de yi mtshan nyid bzhi// ma grub sgrub byed min don rjod// rgol bas khas blangs pa bzung ngo*/ /zhes dang*/ khas blangs de yang tshad ma ni// bdag gis bkag med yin par 'dod// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid kyi skyon de la rigs mi mthun dang*/ log rtog gnyis su yod/ rigs mi mthun ni/ skabs kyi rgol ba'i tshad mas ma grub pa dang*/ tshad mas bsal ba dang*/ dpag 'dod kyi yul du ma byas pa dang gsum la byed/ de gsum ni/ bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid kyi zur gyi ngo bo dang*/ ma bsal ba dang*/ 'dod pa zhes pa'i tshig gis sel bar byed/ log rtog ni/ dpe rtags ma grub pa bsgrub bya yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog /lung don bsgrub bya yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog gnyis la byed/ de gnyis ni bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid kyi zur gyi kho na ba zhes pa dang*/

bdag nyid zhes pa'i tshig gis sel bar byed/ rigs sgo ltar na/ grub bsal med cing rgol bas bsgrub byar khas blangs pa de/ bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ rigs gter las/ mdo las mtshan nyid lnga ldan gsungs// bsgrub byar 'dod pa rigs pa'i sgor// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ming gi rnam grangs ni/ phyogs dang*/ bsgrub bya dang*/ rjes su dpag bya dang*/ bstan bya ba dang*/ tshogs don la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs yin no// gsum pa dbye ba la/ rang don skabs kyi bsgrub bya yang dag dang*/ gzhan don skabs kyi bsgrub bya yang dag gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don skabs kyi ngo bo'i don sogs chos lnga tshang ba/ rang don skabs kyi bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rang don skabs kyi rtags yang dag tu song ba'i tshe sgra mi rtag pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gzhan don skabs kyi bsgrub bya yang dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan don skabs kyi ngo bo'i don sogs chos lnga tshang ba de/ gzhan don skabs kyi bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i gzhan don skabs kyi rtags yang dag tu song ba'i tshe sgra mi rtag pa lta bu/ 'o na sgra mi rtag pa rang mtshan de bsgrub bya yin nam/ sgra mi rtag pa'i gzhan sel de bsgrub bya yin zhe na/ song tshod la sgra mi rtag pa'i gzhan sel de bsgrub bya yin te/ de spyi sgrub par bya yin pas// grub pa sgrub pa nyid ma yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rloms tshod la ni/ sgra mi rtag pa rang mtshan de bsgrub byar rlom pa yin tai/ sgra'i gzhan sel gyi steng du mi rtag pa'i gzhan sel sgrub pa la rgol phyir rgol gnyis ka shes 'dod dang dpag 'dod med pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa'i tshe ni rang mtshan dang gzhan sel so sor ma phye ba'i sgra mi rtag pa tsam zhig sgrub pa yin te/

rigs gter las/ yul dus rnam pas khyad par du ma byas pa'i du ba dang*/ byas pa la sogs pa spyi ldog rtags kyi mtshan gzhi'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i shugs la yul dus rnam pas khyad par du ma byas pa'i sgra mi rtag pa tsam zhig bsgrub bya yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bsgrub bya yang dag yin na rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya dang*/ tshad mas grub pas khyab bo zhe na/ mig sogs bdag don byed pa chos can/ rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya dang tshad mas grub par thal/ bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa'i phyir te/ ma rjod na yang 'dod pas khyab// bdag gi don bzhin bsgrub byar 'dod// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ mig sogs bdag don byed pa chos can/ rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya dang tshad mas grub pa ma yin par thal/ rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya ma yin pa gang zhig /tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ mig sogs bdag don byed pa chos can/ rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya ma yin par thal/ khyod sgrub byed kyi rtags yang dag med pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ mig sogs bdag don byed pa tshad mas ma grub par thal/ bdag shes rig gi skyes bu tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sgra rtag pa chos can/ tshad mas grub par thal/ bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod sgrub byed phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs yod pa'i phyir/ de la khyab pa yod de/ ngo bo tshig phrad bdag nyid 'dod/ /zhes pa'i skabs su bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid de bshad nas/ de sgrub byed phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs de 'chad par byed pa la/ gtan tshigs rab tu dbye ba'i don/ /zhes sogs kyi gzhung rnams byung ba'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la/ phyogs snga ma na re/ sgra rtag pa chos can/ chos dang chos can gyi tshogs don yin par thal/ bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtags kyi bsgrub bya tshogs pa nyid/

/yin phyir/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sgra rtag pa chos can/ bsgrub bya yang dag ma yin par thal/ tshad mas bsal ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bsal ba gtan tshigs rten ma yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sgra rtag pa chos can/ khyod sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs yang dag yod par thal/ khyod bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed do// bzhi pa tshad mas bsal ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad mas grub pa'i don gyi 'gal zla dngos de/ tshad ma'i bsal ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ mngon sum gyi bsal ba dang*/ dngos stobs rjes dpag /grags pa'i rjes dpag /yid ches pa'i rjes dpag dang bzhir yod de/ rjes su dpag pa'i dbye ba yis// gnod pa de yang rnam bzhir bshad// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po mngon sum gyis bsal ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam bzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ so so skye bo'i mngon sum gyis grub pa'i don gyi 'gal zla dngos de/ mngon sum gyis bsal ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag la/ sel byed/ bsal bya/ sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgra rang mtshan mnyan bya yin pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra rang mtshan mnyan bya ma yin pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ des de sel nus pa yin te/ de de'i dngos kyi 'gal zla gang zhig /sgra mnyan bya yin pa de nyan shes mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dngos stobs rjes dpag gis bsal ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos stobs rjes dpag gi tshad mas grub pa'i don gyi 'gal zla dngos de/ dngos stobs rjes dpag gi bsal ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag la/ sel byed/ bsal bya/ sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra mi rtag pa ma yin pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ des de sel nus pa yin te/ de de'i dngos kyi 'gal zla gang zhig /sgra mi rtag pa de dngos po stobs zhugs kyi tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/

gsum pa grags pa'i rjes dpag gis bsal ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ grags pa'i rjes dpag gi tshad mas grub pa'i don gyi 'gal zla dngos de/ grags pa'i rjes dpag gis bsal ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag la/ sel byed/ bsal bya/ sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du rung ba lta bu/ gnyis pa bsal bya ni/ ri bong can zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du mi rung ba lta bu/ gsum pa sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ des de sel nus pa yin te/ de de'i dngos kyi 'gal zla yin pa gang zhig /ri bong can zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du rung ba de 'jig rten gyi grags pas grub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yid ches pa'i rjes dpag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ yid ches rjes dpag gi tshad mas grub pa'i don gyi 'gal zla dngos de/ des bsal ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag la/ sel byed/ bsal bya/ sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /zhes pa'i lung tshig lta bu/ gnyis pa bsal bya ni/ sbyin sogs spyad pa las bde ba mi 'byung ba lta bu/ gsum pa sel nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /zhes pa'i lung tshig chos can/ rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba yin te/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de sgrub byed phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs bshad pa la/ bshad bya'i mdo 'god pa dang*/ mdo'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad ma mdor/ mthun phyogs la yod med rnam gnyis// phyogs kyi chos la'ang rnam pa gsum// mi mthun phyogs la'ang so sor ni// yod med gnyis ka'i bye brag phyir/ /zhes dang*/ rnam nges las/ phyogs chos mthun phyogs yod med dang*// rnam gnyis re re dag la yang*// rnam gsum mi mthun phyogs la yang*//
